notes: One typed contents-continuation page, printed page number - 539 - and archive sheet number 86. It contains 28 live numbered entries (3.8–3.9, 4.1–4.5, 5.1–5.7, 6.1–6.8 and 7.1–7.6), four live section headings, two cancelled starting stubs, a cancelled word, an exchanged overtyped letter pair, and a slashed stray glyph. No independent title or date, authorial question mark or other explicit author doubt is visible. H is description only, so h_reading is null and diff_h is false throughout. Three detached graphical loci omitted by C are preserved with uncertainty of origin and function; their drawn shapes do not assert authorship or a typed/handwritten operation. No inspected locus established a crease or scratch requiring exclusion. Ordinary sheet texture, diffuse background mottling and folds are not transcribed. The full source page and halves were each actually viewed once in prescribed order; all eleven unique retained crops were each actually viewed once, in batches of at most three. Detailed processing and delivery records are in processing.md and crop_processing.json.
